metadata.description: The Easter Bunny needs your help! His five little siblings were practicing their egg-hiding skills and accidentally lost their special family heirloom eggs around the playground. Each egg holds a note for a special family performance at sunset, but now the bunnies can’t remember where they hid them! Explore the Easter Egg Hunt map, search each spot, and find the missing eggs before the big family reunion begins. Can you save the day and keep the tradition alive?
